summary: Iter 7 magic-link auth + cross-device account linking fully tested. Backend pytest suite 12/12 passing; frontend Playwright happy path on mobile 414x896 passes end-to-end (unlinked card -> submit -> dev-link -> /auth/verify success -> auto-redirect to /settings -> linked card -> unlink -> back to unlinked card; /auth/verify with no token shows verify-error). No overflow issues on /settings or /auth/verify at 414x896. RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally unset and dev_link is returned in the API response (explicit dev fallback per the request).
critical_code_review_comments: auth/magic-link/request leaks dev_link in response when RESEND_API_KEY is unset — this is the intended dev fallback per the request, but the README/PRD should explicitly note that RESEND_API_KEY MUST be set before any public/prod deploy, otherwise anyone can hijack any email account by hitting the endpoint and getting a usable verify token in the JSON body.
magic_links collection has no index on `token`; consider db.magic_links.create_index('token', unique=True) and a TTL index on expires_at for automatic cleanup.
accounts collection has no unique index on `email`; concurrent verifies for a new email could race and create duplicate docs. Add unique index.
POST /api/account/unlink uses `body: dict` instead of a Pydantic model — inconsistent with the rest of the API and skips validation.
No rate-limiting on /api/auth/magic-link/request — same device_id can spam unlimited tokens for arbitrary emails (each token is valid 15min). Recommend per-device + per-email throttle.
server.py is ~720 lines — fine for now but approaching the 700-line guideline; magic-link logic could be split into auth.py module.
test_credentials: None required — anonymous device_id + ad-hoc email addresses (TEST_/playwright+ prefixes used).
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own device_ids per test (uuid-based) and use ad-hoc emails; no fixed seed data needed. Direct mongo mutations used to simulate paid lifetime state (per the iter-7 instructions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 7 magic-link auth shipped clean. Backend regression file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_magic_link.py and covers request/verify/cross-device-transfer/unlink/account_me + light regression (init, checkout AUD, affiliate). Older suite at /app/backend/tests/test_premium_api.py is still around for iter 1-6 regression. RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally unset; dev_link in response is the contract — do not flag as a bug. /auth/verify has data-testid='verify-success' | 'verify-error' | 'verify-loading'. AccountLinkCard testids: settings-account-unlinked, settings-account-linked, auth-email-input, auth-send-link, auth-dev-link, dev-link-anchor, linked-email, account-unlink.
